description: This file contains a memory testing utility with functions for memory address validation, random and pattern-based memory filling, comparison, and progress display, along with an interactive memory test launcher.

methods.name: memtest_progress_start
methods.description: Initializes and displays the start of a memory test progress bar with a title and pass number.

methods.name: memtest_progress_end
methods.description: Clears the progress display, marking the end of a progress bar.

methods.name: memtest_progress_step
methods.description: Updates the progress bar with the current progress based on the current and total size.

methods.name: memtest_addressing
methods.description: Tests memory addressing by writing and verifying each location contains its own address.

methods.name: memtest_fill_random
methods.description: Fills memory with pseudo-random data using an xorshift* PRNG.

methods.name: memtest_fill_value
methods.description: Fills memory with two alternating values in a pattern.

methods.name: memtest_compare
methods.description: Checks if two memory regions contain identical data.

methods.name: memtest_compare_times
methods.description: Repeats memory comparison multiple times, accumulating errors.

methods.name: memtest_test
methods.description: Performs multiple memory tests including addressing, random, solid, and checkerboard patterns.

methods.name: memtest_preserving_test
methods.description: Tests memory in small chunks while preserving original content, with cache trashing.

methods.name: memtest_alloc_and_test
methods.description: Allocates specified MB of memory and runs tests on it.

methods.name: memtest
methods.description: Runs a comprehensive memory test on system memory interactively.
